model: none: scripted functional test; no training, no free model decisions (the current adapter c110f964... is untouched)

maiden_script.reading: e5 = ② (QUICK_O, EVENT_FREE_CHAIN, Stringid(id,1)) with SetCountLimit(1)

fixture.note: the functional comparison fixture (no normal draws; effect draws occur)

starts.A: record BV1-1cost-VARNISH-OI replayed by meaning with snapshot equality (opponent script re-run and checked) up to OUR first response to 無限泡影 (target: zone-0 Maiden which used its ② at step 119); Diaktoros② unused at that point
starts.B: record BV1-2cost-ASSAULT-OI replayed for turn 1; from turn 2 every optional own activation declined in every phase until 無限泡影; target: the turn-1 Maiden (the only Maiden; same priority rule, checked legal)

conditions.A-I-N: Diaktoros② on Imperm; opponent then does nothing
conditions.A-I-P: pass on Imperm; opponent then does nothing
conditions.A-IM-N: Diaktoros② on Imperm; then opponent normal summons Medius + ① (獄神獣 SS if it resolves); at our Medius① window Diaktoros② if legal else pass
conditions.A-IM-P: pass on Imperm; then the same Medius sequence and rule
conditions.B-N: Diaktoros② on Imperm; then the original Maiden② once (EX Maiden; Finemelt + Litera)
conditions.B-P: pass on Imperm; then the same Maiden② attempt

own_rule: only the named actions; every other optional own activation declined (legal Cancel) for the whole comparison; forced prompts: select_place first, select_position face-up attack else first, select_unselect_card finish when offered, otherwise first option (logged); one-candidate auto prompts not skipped
opponent_rule: passes except: main phase 1 of turn 2 with an empty field, 無限泡影 from the hand (target priority 乙女 > ディアクトロス > ファインメルト > 獄神使 > other, lowest zone); IM only: after the Imperm chain resolved, normal summon Medius, activate ①, choose 獄神獣, special summon; no attack

stop.B: the first decision after the Maiden② chain resolved (or turn 3 if ② never offered)

not_a_label: whether Medius follows is the opponent's unpublished plan at the Imperm window; the A-I vs A-IM difference measures the opportunity cost, it is not a label for the Imperm window

reuse.rule: an existing record is reused only if, over the cut range, the fixture, the rules, every executed action and the end point are the same

A_I_N.why: identical to the A-I-N rule up to the first turn-3 decision

engine.plan: 6 conditions x (record + replay) = 12, minus reuse; 2 spare for a harness fix only

record_items: target Maiden status column (disabled or forbidden) before / after Imperm and whether its ② is offered
Diaktoros② use and its legality at Medius①
Medius effect resolution, 獄神獣 arrival (not confused with destruction)
own / opponent field, hand, GY, banished, LP; consumed once-per-turn uses
B: ② offered / activated / fusion selection shown / materials moved / new fusion monster (classified separately)
